BOTDEFENSE::support_id
Description
This iRules command returns the support ID of the request.
Syntax
BOTDEFENSE
::
support_id
Examples
# EXAMPLE: Log the support ID of the request.
when
BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST
{
set
log
"support id is"
append
log
" [BOTDEFENSE::support_id]"
HSL
::
send
$hsl
$log
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST, BOTDEFENSE_ACTION
